title: Frankenstein’s Mummy
description: A mad scientist, tucked away in his lab, finally has a breakthrough in his experimentation.
quote: At last, I have perfected the equipment that will allow me to transform my creation into human form! And it’s all right here in my secret laboratory!
altHero: Dr. Frankenstein, a mad scientist, next to a woman on an experiment table
alt2: the woman making a face, tongue out
